tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Lists catalogue items by their store number (hero-12, app-crm-01, template-home), optionally filtered. access: open (free, no key) or pro (UI Pro). kind: ui (primitive), block (page section), app (app screen), template (whole page). category: e.g. "hero", "pricing", "footer", "app-crm", "templates".

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Finds items by words in their name, title and description, best match first. Example: "pricing table", "sign in form".

tools.name: show_item
tools.description: One item: what it is, who may install it, and, when the caller may, its registry entry with the files and their code.

tools.name: install_item
tools.description: Checks that the caller may install the items and returns the shadcn command to run in the project, plus the components.json entry for the @themesdev namespace. Run the command yourself; this tool changes nothing.
